c74object.name: evi_blitwaves
c74object.digest: evieve Gen Object. No aliasing BLIT oscillators with a choice of simultaneous wave shapes outputs
c74object.description:
evi_blitwaves is an abstraction for using inside gen~ or GenExpr.
evi_blitwaves.gendsp requires the GenExpr file(s):
evi_smooth.genexpr, evi_trig.genexpr, evi_adaa.genexpr
evi_blitwaves is also available in MSP as: evi.blitwaves~.
No aliasing classic synth wave shapes, DSF-BLIT-like algorithm, sweep/modulation works with no noise, and cheap. Good for subtractive synthesis because we stay very bright right up to nyquist, but no hard sync.

geninlet.name: frequency
geninlet.digest: in Hz. Oscillator frequency in Hz.

geninlet.name: pulse
geninlet.digest: Width 0..1 @default 0.5. PWM 0..1 for wave shapes that use it (RECT, TRI and Train)

geninlet.name: naive
geninlet.digest: Reset. Naive phase reset, not antialiased.

attribute.name: addsine
attribute.description: 0 = SINE off, 1 = SINE on out of outlet 4 (CPU management)

attribute.name: addsync
attribute.description: 0 = off, 1 = main phase output out of outlet 6, 2 = pwm phase output out of outlet 6

attribute.name: addtrain
attribute.description: 0 = off, 1 = train based on main phase out of outlet 5, 2 = train based on pwm phase out of outlet 5

attribute.name: smooth
attribute.description: Internal parameters smoothed by this time in ms. Turn off (0) for audio rate modulation of inlets 1 and 2
